description: AUTOMATIC recognition of the evidence-accumulation generator from a raw observation TRAJECTORY, closing the gap LOGODDS_GENERATOR_RESULTS.md Sec7.1 named and left un-built ('DimInfer/TimeInfer automatic recognition of this generator from a raw observation trajectory, rather than explicit declaration, is named as separate, un-sized follow-on work'). LOGODDS_DIMINFER_PREREG.md's decision: TimeInfer, not DimInfer -- DimInfer's rung-2 candidate-generator loop is architecturally unreached for a single (evidence_confirm, evidence_disconfirm) relation compared pairwise (build_candidate's tier-1 uniform-delta check is vacuously true for one aligned pair, so TransformDecode's rung-1 already explains any such delta with zero residual for DimInfer to add value over -- confirmed live in tests/test_evidence_axis_infer.py, not merely by source-reading). The problem is genuinely a TRAJECTORY (repeated real-world confirm/disconfirm observations across ticks), which is TimeInfer's own stated territory, and TimeInfer needs no pre-declared generator at all -- it infers kind/offset fresh from the data (generate-and-test on the first pair), so this seed never touches or depends on seeds/inference_knowledge.json's pre-declared 'logodds_evidence' DimensionGenerator. Two rules, mirroring two already-landed idioms exactly: evidence_axis_sample_window mirrors seeds/f16_flight_path_control.json's f16_sample_axis_margins (an Append/ListDrop/Count rolling sample-window Tuple attr, capped at a fixed ENGINEERING buffer size of 6 samples -- not a borrowed human perceptual-bin count, CAN_SOLVER_THEORETICAL_LIMITS_RESEARCH.md Sec5.3/Sec7's own caution against exactly that; 6 is chosen only to hold enough of a pure-reinforcement run to recognize plus enough of a gapped run to demonstrate the no-spurious-mint null, the same sizing logic f16's own cap uses). evidence_axis_infer mirrors seeds/shape_decode_loop.json's sd_recognize_dim (TimeInfer's field-selected output feeds an add_node_if_absent-minted DimensionGenerator{kind:'translate'} + LatentDimension{name:'latent:causal_strength_inferred'}, content-keyed dedup per DEDUP_ADOPTION_SWEEP_RESULTS.md v1.9.0, guarded against re-mint by a has_inferred_axis edge -- the same fixpoint-safety idiom sd_recognize_dim's has_transform-edge guard uses). PER-DIRECTION only, by design: this seed tracks the evidence_confirm axis alone (the SAME per-direction convention LOGODDS_GENERATOR_RESULTS.md Sec3 already uses for the two counters on one Coactivation node) -- the coupled 2-D (confirm, disconfirm) trajectory is NOT a shape TimeInfer's single-constant-generator orbit test can explain (an event-conditional per-tick offset that changes direction is not a constant-velocity orbit, and not a regular finite-difference stream either), which LOGODDS_DIMINFER_PREREG.md registers and LOGODDS_DIMINFER_RESULTS.md demonstrates directly as a real, honest scope boundary, not a defect. Reads evidence_confirm only; never writes evidence_confirm/evidence_disconfirm/evidence_tick or any key the log-odds render (Log(Div(Plus(confirm,1),Plus(disconfirm,1)))) depends on -- the inferred generator sits ALONGSIDE the existing Hebbian mechanism as additional graph data, never a parallel or disconnected one. Zero new Rust: TimeInfer (existing, shape_decode.rs) is the only Term this seed calls beyond the ordinary Attr/Plus/Gt/Gte/Eq/Not/And/Count/Append/ListDrop/MapList/Vec/IfThenElse arithmetic every other CAN-native rule already uses.
